scope: Every timed choice must equal its authenticated full-panel prediction. Audit independently repeats288 seed/root/method native choices; timing durations are authenticated, not rerun. Same process and paired ordering limit but do not eliminate host-load, cache or thermal effects. Measures scalar complete native decisions, not throughput or hardware-general speed. Stored parameter counts do not match FLOPs; no new training, engine calls, quality criterion or novelty claim.
